opinions.point: Most commenters found the episode highly entertaining, praising its exaggerated comedy and increasingly absurd tone.
Several commenters enjoyed seeing more attention given to side characters, including older characters and university students.
Some felt the short-form slice-of-life approach was fun and wished the franchise had produced this kind of material more often.
One reaction enjoyed the episode overall but felt it lacked enough tank-action spectacle.
A commenter criticized the quality of the Russian-language performance, particularly its accent and phrasing.

title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan

thread.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan • FX Senshi Kurumi-chan - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode’s intense, stressful depiction of risky trading and found the psychological angle unusually compelling.
Some praised the humor, especially the contrast between the characters’ confidence and their reckless decisions.
Commenters found the characters entertaining but increasingly difficult to root for because of their impulsiveness, greed, and poor risk management.
Many reacted negatively to Mebuki’s repeated refusal to stop, describing her behavior as frustrating, painful to watch, and based more on luck than understanding.
Yasuko was often viewed as the most sensible character because she was comparatively willing to limit losses, though commenters still considered her choices risky.
Some appreciated the apparent realism and technical detail around market volatility, while others noted dramatization and questioned specific financial or time-setting details.
